# ShunyaScape

> ShunyaScape is a free third-person battle royale shooter that runs in the web browser. Each match drops you onto a 640-metre map of towns, fields, forests and hills with 24 AI soldiers. You loot guns, ammo and med kits from houses and crates, and fight to be the last one standing while a blue zone shrinks the play area.

## Key facts

- Genre: battle royale, third-person shooter
- Platform: any modern web browser; WebGPU when available, WebGL 2 otherwise; no download or install
- Price: free to play; a free account (Google or email) is required
- Match: 1 player against 24 AI soldiers; the soldiers only hunt the player
- Map: 640 × 640 m with nine towns of enterable houses, roads, forests, fields and hills
- Zone: 30-second ceasefire, then six shrinking phases; outside the zone you lose health every second
- Multiplayer: not yet; online play is planned

## Weapons and loot

- M416: 5.56mm, 30 rounds, full-auto, red-dot sight
- Kar98k: 7.62mm, 5 rounds, bolt action, 4× scope
- P92: 9mm, 15 rounds, semi-auto pistol (you start with one)
- Ammo boxes and med kits (full heal in 4.5 s) are picked up automatically

## Controls

- W/A/S/D move, mouse looks, left click shoots, right click aims or scopes
- Space jumps, Shift sprints
- U reload, I pick up, J crouch, K prone, O switch weapon, L use med kit, 1/2/3 weapon slots

## Links

- Play: the home page of this site
